title: An endemic pathway to sheep and goat domestication at Aşıklı Höyük (Central Anatolia, Turkey)
version: PNAS 119, e2110930119, DOI 10.1073/pnas.2110930119. Author list abbreviated.
lineage: Expanded faunal study of the Aşıklı sequence with excavator overlap with the 2014 study. Includes Level 5 and reassesses caprine management through time.

passages.locator: Abstract; Results; Discussion, The Domesticatory Process at Aşıklı Höyük
passages.note: The authors infer initial small-scale management around 8400 cal BCE, followed by more substantial captive reproduction and livestock production.
